title: New Wave L'Extrait de Parfum Travel Spray
descriptionHtml:
Fragrance Family: Florals

Scent Type: Warm Florals

Key Notes: Pink Pepper, Honeyed Floral, Benzoin, Oakwood

Fragrance Description: This long-lasting fragrance balances bright optimism with a deep, sensual base. It opens with pink pepper and green aromatics, unfolding into a radiant solar floral heart. As it wears, it settles into a rich base of incense, woods, and vanilla, leaving an addictive trail that feels warm and powerful.

About the Bottle: Inspired by surrealist art, the custom glass bottle is designed to evoke the gentle movement of a wave—a symbol of continuous motion and change.

About the Fragrance: New Wave is a deeply addictive scent that honors the traditions of classical fragranc
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Spray onto your wrists, neck, and pulse points; the natural warmth of your body will help diffuse the scent throughout the day.
-Avoid rubbing or dabbing your skin as this breaks down the fragrance, causing it to wear off more quickly.
Ingredients+
Ingredients: Alcohol Denat., Fragrance (Parfum), Tetramethyl Acetyloctahydronaphthalenes, Water (Aqua/Eau), Vanillin, Butyl Methoxydibenzoylmethane, Hexadecanolactone, Cananga Odorata Oil/Extract, Isoeugenyl Acetate, Terpineol, Juniperus Virginiana Oil, Coumarin, Beta-Caryophyllene, Linalool, Geranyl Acetate, Pinene, Limonene, Benzyl Benzoate, Citrus Aurantium Flower Oil, Pogostemon Cablin Oil, Linalyl Acetate, Farnesol, Carvone, Alpha-Terpinene, Terpinolene, Benzyl Salicylate, Geraniol.

The list of ingredients is subject to change. Please consult the packaging of the product purchased.
